L2().details: Sets up the L2 contracts. Depends on `L1()` being called first.

proposeAnotherOutput().details: Helper function to propose an output.

setUp().details: Deploys the Deploy contract without including its bytecode in the bytecode      of this contract by fetching the bytecode dynamically using `vm.getCode()`.      If the Deploy bytecode is included in this contract, then it will double      the compile time and bloat all of the test contract artifacts since they      will also need to include the bytecode for the Deploy contract.      This is a hack as we are pushing solidity to the edge.

test_constructor_succeeds().details: Tests that the implementation is initialized correctly.

test_initialize_succeeds().details: Tests that the proxy is initialized correctly.

test_messageVersion_succeeds().details: Tests that `messageNonce` can be decoded correctly.

test_relayMessage_customGasToken_noValue.details: Tests that the relayMessage succeeds with a custom gas token when the call value is zero.

test_relayMessage_customGasToken_withVal.details: Tests that the relayMessage reverts when call value is non-zero with custom gas token.       The L1CrossDomainMessenger `sendMessage` function cannot send value with a custom gas token.

test_relayMessage_retry_succeeds().details: Tests that `relayMessage` is able to send a successful call      to the target contract after the first message fails and ETH      gets stuck, but the second message succeeds.

test_relayMessage_toSystemContract_rever.details: Tests that `relayMessage` reverts if attempting to relay      a message sent to an L1 system contract.

test_relayMessage_v2_reverts().details: Tests that `sendMessage` reverts if the message version is not supported.

test_sendMessage_customGasToken_noValue_.details: Tests that sendMessage succeeds with a custom gas token when the call value is zero.

test_sendMessage_customGasToken_withValu.details: Tests that the sendMessage reverts when call value is non-zero with custom gas token.

test_sendMessage_twice_succeeds().details: Tests that `sendMessage` can be called twice and that      the nonce increments correctly.

test_xDomainMessageSender_reset_succeeds.details: Tests that `relayMessage` correctly resets the `xDomainMessageSender`      to the original value after a message is relayed.

test_xDomainSender_senderNotSet_reverts(.details: Tests that `sendMessage` reverts if the recipient is the zero address.
